summary: T Stamp Inc. filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026 disclosing an Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC for an at-the-market program. The company may sell up to $5,323,474 of Class A common stock from time to time through Maxim as sales agent or principal, under its effective Form S-3 shelf. Maxim earns a 3.0% gross commission plus up to $40,000 expense reimbursement and $3,000 quarterly counsel fees. No shares are committed; sales are discretionary and subject to baby-shelf limits. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation; watch dilution and ATM utilization.
